name: FileStreamBot
description: A Telegram Bot to Convert Telegram Files To Direct & Streamable Links.

ENV.description: Set this to True if you don't want to crash the bot

FLOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of Channel Where store files sent by users. Read the readme for more info about this var

ULOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of Channel Where store New Users data. Read the readme for more info about this var

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram User ID as Owner

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB URI for saving User Data and Files List created by user.

AUTH_USERS.description: Put IDs of Auth Usrs where bot will work. You can add multiple IDs & separate with Space.

UPDATES_CHANNEL.description: Channel Username without `@` to set channel as Update Channel

FORCE_SUB_ID.description: Channel ID starts with -100 to set channel as Force Sub Channel

FORCE_SUB.description: Set to True, so every user have to Join update channel to use the bot.

SLEEP_THRESHOLD.description: Set global flood wait threshold, auto-retry requests under 60s.

WORKERS.description: No. of workers that is to be assigned.

PORT.description: The port that you want your webapp to be listened to

NO_PORT.description: If you don't want your port to be displayed. Set True or False

HAS_SSL.description: true if your public URL is https (Render/Koyeb: true).

BIND_ADDRESS.description: Your server bind address. default to 0.0.0.0

FQDN.description: Public hostname of your deployment, e.g. my-bot.onrender.com. Needed for stream links AND for auto-ping to know its own URL.

SESSION_NAME.description: Name for the Database created on your MongoDB. Defaults to FileStream

FILE_PIC.description: To set Image at /files command. Defaults to pre-set image.

START_PIC.description: To set Image at /start command. Defaults to pre-set image.

VERIFY_PIC.description: To set Image at Force Subscribe Verify. Defaults to pre-set image.

MODE.description: Should be set to `secondary` if you only want to use the server for serving files.

AUTO_PING.description: true/false. Force-enable or disable the self keep-alive pinger. Leave unset to auto-detect based on FQDN (recommended for Render/Koyeb free tiers).

PING_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between self-pings to keep a free-tier web service awake. Default 600.

CHUNK_SIZE.description: Bytes fetched from Telegram per request while streaming. Default 1048576 (1 MiB). Try 2097152 on fast connections for fewer round trips.

MAX_STREAMS_PER_IP.description: Max concurrent /dl downloads allowed from one IP. 0 disables the cap. Default 8.

RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.description: Max /dl or /watch requests allowed per IP per RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW seconds. 0 disables. Default 60.

MULTI_TOKEN1.description: Optional extra bot token (or user session string) for load-balanced streaming. Add MULTI_TOKEN2, MULTI_TOKEN3, etc. for more.
